==Description==
'''Area 52''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]] that takes place in a military base.

==Design & Path==
'''Area 52''' is located in a desert. It is surrounded by hills on most of its sides. A part of it that is not surrounded by hills has a fence built there, with an entrance to the area. There is a large runway with hangers and multiple planes on it. There are also two buildings next to it, one of them also having an air traffic control tower. There are also a few small buildings and rocks scattered across the map. A small cliff can be found inside of '''Area 52''', with a flag on it.

The black pavement path starts at a cave and ends at a metal bunker. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding obstacles.

{{Map:Area 52}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The cliff near the entrance is a great spot for cliff towers, as you can place a lot of cliff towers there.
**This spot also allows cliff towers to cover most of the map.
*Long range towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Hunter]] can easily cover most of the path.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at increasing the tower's range, which may allow some towers to cover the entire path.
*There are multiple decent spots for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], as they allow them to have path in their range for most of their flight path.

==Trivia==
*Near the entrance to '''Area 52''', three signs can be found. Two of them are warning signs, which warn you that '''Area 52''' is a Tower Defense Simulator map. The punishment for unauthorized personnel entering '''Area 52''' is losing 100 credits and not triumphing.
**The other sign is meant to tell that you cannot use drones near '''Area 52'''.
**"Losing 100 credits and not triumphing" is a reference from ''Tower Battles'' [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Versus|Versus]] mode, if a player leaves during a match, they will lose 50 credits and add 1 loss.
*The map is based on the [[Area 51]] map from the [[Area 51 Event]].
*There are [[wp:General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]]s on the aircraft runway and hangar.
